title: Liverpool host Arsenal with Chelsea and Manchester United opening the weekend
summary: The Premier League returns with Chelsea v Manchester United at 12:30 on Saturday, then Manchester City v Brighton, Spurs v Crystal Palace and Aston Villa v Fulham later the same day, before Liverpool v Arsenal at 16:30 on Sunday. Newcastle v Everton closes the round on Monday night, four days after the same pair meet in the Carabao Cup.
